hotels.title: Sophisticated Zadar Seafront Escape with Hyatt Regency Luxury
hotels.description: Set on Zadar’s seafront beside the city’s historic core, this polished Adriatic retreat places Roman ruins, marble lanes and the 9th-century Church of St Donatus within easy reach. The Sea Organ and Sun Salutation are a short stroll away, where waves create music against the waterfront promenade. Inside, sleek rooms and suites pair contemporary lines with views across the old town or glittering coast. Spend afternoons at the spa and indoor pool, then dine on Dalmatian seafood in the hotel’s restaurants or wander to Pet Bunara for black risotto and grilled Adriatic fish
